items.title: Norman Mason Interview, 1960-02-06
items.q: The interviewee narrates Van Lewis's career, mentioning Lewis playing with Erskine Tate's band and his own band, but does not describe a direct personal or professional interaction between himself and Van Lewis.

ctx.x: The boy by the name of, uh... Boyd Atkins. Boyd Atkins was playing the violin in the band, you know. And, uh... He left the band and went to Chicago. And, uh... They had a... They had a little paper or something around Chicago called Heba Jeebus. They had to... Used to... Used to have a... Either the paper or... They had some... A little deal.
